Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Danuel House Jr.?

Danuel House Jr. is 33 years old.

Where was Danuel House Jr. born?

Danuel House Jr. was born in Houston, Texas.

When was Danuel House Jr. born?

Danuel House Jr. was born on June 7, 1993.

How tall is Danuel House Jr.?

Danuel House Jr. is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much did Danuel House Jr. weigh when playing?

Danuel House Jr. weighed 220 lbs (99 kg) when playing.

What position did Danuel House Jr. play?

Small Forward and Shooting Guard.

When did Danuel House Jr. retire?

Danuel House Jr. last played in 2024.

What is Danuel House Jr.'s net worth?

Danuel House Jr. made at least $19,048,473 playing professional basketball.

How much did Danuel House Jr. make?

Danuel House Jr. made $4,310,250 in 2024.

What did Danuel House Jr. average?

Danuel House Jr. averaged 7.3 points, 3.0 rebounds, and 1.1 assists per game.

What is Danuel House Jr.'s Instagram account?

Danuel House Jr. is on Instagram at dk2house.

What schools did Danuel House Jr. attend?

Danuel House Jr. attended Hightower in Missouri City, Texas and Texas A&M.
